about: World hashes after N game days (N x steps_per_day steps from a fresh world). The ONE shared fixture for determinism evidence: asserted natively and in wasm by crates/client-wasm/tests/runner_golden.rs, and under the Bun runner by packages/runner/test/golden.test.ts. When sim-core changes the world on purpose, regenerate with: for each case, bun packages/runner/src/cli.ts run --seed S --days N --world W --json (sim.final.hash), then run both tests. Re-baselined for world format 2 (FEAT-079, ADR-0059): a standup nobody answers now raises a StandupFailed ticket, so every demo case that runs past 10:00 of day 0 moved; the step-0 world and the empty company (no meetings, tickets or work items) encode as before. Re-baselined for world format 3 (FEAT-087, ADR-0069): the plan carries workstreams and board days and every work item its planned days, so every case moved, the step-0 world and the empty company included; the editorial board is off unless a command turns it on, so no case holds one.
